intro:
Idar is one of the older towns in Sabarkantha district, built around a striking hilltop fort and a history that stretches back through several princely dynasties, which gives the town a distinct sense of place that newer towns simply don't have. A baraat winding through Idar's streets, with the old fort visible in the background, has a real sense of occasion built into it.

Plan My Baraat handles the complete entry for Idar weddings as one booking: the double decker Baraat on Wheels truck, a dhol team, a vintage car or baggi for the groom's arrival, and the My Safa team turban-styling him and the full baraati group.
localArea:
Idar sits in the hillier part of Sabarkantha district, at the base of the fort hill, and its roads mix older, narrower town lanes with more open stretches on the outskirts where most current wedding venues sit. We plan the truck's exact route with the older core in mind, particularly for venues closer to the fort area.

We cover Idar and the surrounding villages regularly, and given how much local pride is tied to the town's history, families here often want their baraat entry to match that sense of grandeur with a full truck and dhol production.
whatsIncluded:
Every package includes the DJ truck, sound system, and a DJ artist keeping the crowd engaged as the baraat moves. Raj Tilak comes with 2 dhol and chhatri lighting. Rajwada steps up to 4 dhol and adds a teddy or gorilla performer alongside the truck. Maharaja, the package most Idar families choose, brings moving LED panels and lights up the groom's name for the arrival. Signature, our top package, adds a security team, timed pyro and confetti, and an upgraded American vintage car for the entrance.

The vintage car or baggi and the My Safa turban team are included in every package from Raj Tilak upward, so even the entry-level booking gives you a proper, complete arrival.
whyUs:
We're a Gujarat-based baraat planning team covering Sabarkantha district regularly, and Idar is one we know well, with crews comfortable navigating the hillier, more historic parts of town alongside the newer outer venues.

With one team handling the truck, dhol, car, and safa, you avoid coordinating four separate vendors yourself during a busy final week. We manage the timing so the truck's arrival, the dhol beat, and the groom's step out of the vintage car all land together at your Idar venue.
pricingGuidance:
Pricing for an Idar baraat depends on your package, dhol count, and any added effects like pyro or confetti. Raj Tilak is the most affordable way to get the complete core setup; Signature costs more because it's a genuinely bigger production, with more dhol, LED visuals, a security team, and the premium American vintage car included.

Send us your date, your venue or area in Idar, and a rough guest count, and we'll respond on WhatsApp with a real quote, usually within the hour, built around the specifics of your event.
planningNotes:
Wedding season runs November to February, and Idar sees less competition for dates than bigger towns in the district, so 2 to 3 weeks' notice in peak season is usually enough. Outside that window, a week's notice generally works fine for planning purposes.

Because of the hillier terrain around Idar's fort, it helps to flag your venue's exact location when you message us, so we can plan the truck's route properly in advance.
closing: Message us on WhatsApp with your wedding date, your venue in Idar, and an approximate baraati headcount, and we'll confirm the truck's availability along with a package recommendation, usually within the hour, tailored to your event.

faqs.a: Yes, Idar is built around a striking hilltop fort with a history spanning several princely dynasties, and that heritage still shapes the town's identity.

faqs.q: Can the truck reach venues near Idar's fort area?
faqs.a: In most cases yes, though those lanes are narrower and hillier, so we plan the truck's exact route in advance for those venues. We coordinate the exact approach with local contacts beforehand.

faqs.a: 2 to 3 weeks ahead in peak season, which runs November to February, is usually enough, since Idar sees less date competition than bigger towns.

faqs.q: Do you cover the villages around Idar too?
faqs.a: Yes, we regularly serve the villages surrounding Idar as part of our wider Sabarkantha district coverage, not just the main town centre.

faqs.q: Is the vintage car included in every package?
faqs.a: Yes, starting from Raj Tilak. The Signature package upgrades this to a premium American vintage car for the entrance. This applies across every one of our four packages.

faqs.q: What's the difference between Rajwada and Maharaja?
faqs.a: Rajwada has 4 dhol and a teddy or gorilla performer. Maharaja steps up to 6 dhol and adds moving LED panels with the groom's name lit up. Both tiers include the vintage car and full safa styling as standard.

faqs.q: Does the safa team style the whole baraati group in Idar?
faqs.a: Yes, My Safa ties turbans for the groom and everyone walking in the baraat, arriving early enough for everyone to be ready well on time.
